title: Population-based analysis of POT1 variants in a cutaneous melanoma case-control cohort.
authors: Simonin-Wilmer, Irving; Ossio, Raul; Leddin, Emmett M; Harland, Mark; Pooley, Karen A; Martil de la Garza, Mauricio Gerardo; Obolenski, Sofia; Hewinson, James; Wong, Chi C; Iyer, Vivek; Taylor, John C; Newton-Bishop, Julia A; Bishop, D Timothy; Cisneros, Gerardo Andres; Iles, Mark M; Adams, David J; Robles-Espinoza, Carla Daniela
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过测序和分子动力学模拟分析POT1基因变异对端粒结合的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和MD方法，但对象为端粒蛋白而非典型TF-DNA体系，且以人群遗传学为主，互作机制深度有限。
abstract: Pathogenic germline variants in the protection of telomeres 1 gene (POT1) have been associated with predisposition to a range of tumour types, including melanoma, glioma, leukaemia and cardiac angiosarcoma. We sequenced all coding exons of the POT1 gene in 2928 European-descent melanoma cases and 3298 controls, identifying 43 protein-changing genetic variants. We performed POT1-telomere binding assays for all missense and stop-gained variants, finding nine variants that impair or disrupt protein-telomere complex formation, and we further define the role of variants in the regulation of telomere length and complex formation through molecular dynamics simulations. We determine that POT1 coding variants are a minor contributor to melanoma burden in the general population, with only about 0.5% of melanoma cases carrying germline pathogenic variants in this gene, but should be screened in individuals with a strong family history of melanoma and/or multiple malignancies.
abstract_zh: 端粒保护蛋白1基因（POT1）中的致病性种系变异与多种肿瘤类型的易感性相关，包括黑色素瘤、胶质瘤、白血病和心脏血管肉瘤。我们对2928例欧洲裔黑色素瘤病例和3298例对照者的POT1基因所有编码外显子进行了测序，鉴定出43个蛋白质改变性遗传变异。我们对所有错义变异和无义变异进行了POT1-端粒结合实验，发现9个变异损害或破坏蛋白质-端粒复合物形成，并通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟进一步明确了变异在端粒长度调控和复合物形成中的作用。我们确定POT1编码变异在普通人群中对黑色素瘤负担的贡献较小，仅约0.5%的黑色素瘤病例携带该基因的种系致病性变异，但应在具有强烈黑色素瘤家族史和/或多发性恶性肿瘤的个体中进行筛查。
